Notes , , Appendix:Greek verbs | 1. This verb conjugates as 2nd Conjugation Class B (with -είς, -ούμαι endings) and colloquially as Class A (with -α, -ιέμαι endings)., 2. The forms -ούμουν(α), -ούσουν
